source_query: select row_to_json(c) as raw_catalog,md5(row_to_json(c)::text) as raw_md5,n.nspname as namespace,pg_get_userbyid(c.collowner) as owner,pg_collation_actual_version(c.oid) as actual_version from pg_catalog.pg_collation c join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.collnamespace order by n.nspname collate "C",c.collname collate "C",c.oid limit 220 offset 440
